The dancer wears a floral wreath, a white blouse with embroidered details, and a long skirt. Colorful ribbons (red, yellow, green) extend from the top of the frame downwards, indicating the presence of the maypole structure above. In the background, other participants and spectators are visible on a grassy field with trees.
